name: Authority comparison table
summary: From the opinions, statutes and regulations counsel selected, and only those, the researching lawyer gets one side-by-side table: each authority's court, date, stated issue, operative words, posture and separate opinions, quoted with pinpoints, and a list of every quotation to check. The lawyer decides what applies.

sources.title: Its own published map of law-firm work: the illustrative entry on comparing the authorities counsel has selected.
